ev: `We are also exceptionally gifted at telling smells apart, even in the case of two molecules whose only difference is that their structures are mirror images of one another.

ev: he suggested that mammals can be classed into two broad groups: macrosmatic mammals
15.why: Thông tin: phân loại các loài theo độ nhạy khứu giác. Đoạn B: Broca chia động vật có vú thành nhóm khứu giác nhạy (macrosmatic) và kém nhạy (microsmatic) → B.

ev: when men were subjected to a novel smell - either good or bad - during a task used to test decision-making skills, they performed significantly worse than normal
16.why: Thông tin: mùi làm giảm khả năng ra quyết định. Đoạn F: khi ngửi mùi lạ, đàn ông làm bài kiểm tra ra quyết định kém hơn hẳn → F.

ev: One study, for example, found that we can detect certain chemicals diluted in water to less than one part per billion.

ev: Noses have certainly never been at the forefront of sensory research, and were pushed aside until recently in favour of the seemingly more vital senses of vision and hearing.

ev: The power of smell will be no news to estate agents, who often advocate the smell of baking bread or brewing coffee to promote the sale of a house.

ev: Rob Holland, of the University of Utrecht in the Netherlands, found that the hint of aroma wafting out of a hidden bucket of citrus-scented cleaner was enough to persuade students in a hostel to clean up after themselves

ev: Charles Greer at Yale University in the United States has shown that the human nose and brain are unusually well connected, with each group of receptors linking to many more neural regions than is the case in other animals

ev: The researchers conclude the scent stimulated brain areas connected with emotion, making their decisions emotional rather than rational.

ev: we, along with other primates and the marine mammals, are microsmatic - we have small olfactory organs that we only rely on to a small extent

ev: there are certain brain areas dedicated to both emotion and olfaction, such as the amygdala

ev: the link between a memory and a smell is stronger if the smell is unpleasant rather than pleasant

ev: this explains why smells often transport us back to our childhood
26.why: Câu: trong các giác quan, khứu giác có khả năng gợi ký ức về ___. Bài: mùi thường đưa ta trở về tuổi thơ (childhood) → childhood.
